# Visit Italy

> > Comprehensive travel guide to Italy's regions, cities, and cultural heritage, featuring itineraries, accommodations, and authentic Italian experiences.

Visit Italy provides detailed destination guides covering historic cities, natural parks, coastal regions, and cultural traditions across Italian regions including Umbria, Basilicata, Lazio, Molise, and beyond. The site offers practical travel information, family-friendly itineraries, seasonal recommendations, and insights into Italy's UNESCO sites, cuisine, and Made in Italy excellence.

## Key Topics

- Umbria
- Basilicata
- Naples & Campania
- Bologna & Emilia-Romagna
- Verona & Veneto
- Perugia
- Assisi
- Historic centers (borghi storici)
- Tourist itineraries (itinerari turistici)
- Panoramic viewpoints (punti panoramici)
- Archaeological sites (archeologia)
- National parks & nature
- Family travel with children
- Made in Italy products
- Italian cuisine & traditions

## Major Cities & Historic Centers

- [Verona: tutte le tappe imperdibili della città](https://www.visititaly.eu/it/luoghi-e-itinerari/verona-tutte-le-tappe-imperdibili-della-citta): Verona essential sights: Arena, Romeo & Juliet landmarks, historic bridges
- [Sleeping in the historic center of Naples](https://www.visititaly.eu/places-and-tours/sleeping-in-the-historic-center-of-naples): Accommodation guide to Naples historic center with MANN museum nearby
- [Panoramic points in Bologna: where to take the best photos](https://www.visititaly.eu/places-and-tours/panoramic-points-in-bologna): Bologna viewpoints: Asinelli Tower, San Michele & photography spots
- [Punti panoramici di Perugia](https://www.visititaly.eu/it/luoghi-e-itinerari/punti-panoramici-di-perugia): Guide to Perugia's panoramic viewpoints: Belvedere Carducci & terraces
- [Spoleto in un giorno: cosa fare e cosa vedere](https://www.visititaly.eu/it/luoghi-e-itinerari/spoleto-in-un-giorno-cosa-fare-e-cosa-vedere): One-day itinerary for Spoleto: Ponte delle Torri & Rocca Albornoziana
- [Scopri Campobasso, la città dai due centri storici](https://www.visititaly.eu/it/luoghi-e-itinerari/scopri-campobasso-la-citta-dai-due-centri-storici): Campobasso guide: Molise capital with Castello Monforte & dual centers

## Regional Destinations & Itineraries

- [What to see in Umbria: ten unmissable places](https://www.visititaly.eu/places-and-tours/what-to-see-in-umbria-ten-unmissable-places): Top 10 Umbria destinations: Assisi, Lake Trasimeno & medieval cities
- [Civita di Bagnoregio: dove si trova, come arrivare e cosa vedere](https://www.visititaly.eu/it/luoghi-e-itinerari/a-civita-di-bagnoregio-il-tempo-si-e-fermato): Travel guide to Civita di Bagnoregio, Tuscia's 'dying city' near Viterbo
- [Maratea, la perla del Tirreno](https://www.visititaly.eu/it/luoghi-e-itinerari/maratea-la-perla-del-tirreno): Maratea guide: Basilicata's beaches, Cristo Redentore & Monte San Biagio
- [Riviera del Conero and Colli dell'Infinito: wild nature and breathtaking beaches](https://www.visititaly.eu/places-and-tours/riviera-del-conero-e-colli-dell-infinito-wild-nature-and-breathtaking-beaches): Conero Riviera UNESCO site: Marche beaches & medieval villages near Ancona
- [Magna Grecia o California? No, è Metaponto](https://www.visititaly.eu/it/luoghi-e-itinerari/magna-grecia-o-california-no-e-metaponto-): Metaponto guide: Basilicata's Magna Grecia ruins & Ionian beaches

## National Parks & Nature

- [Parco Nazionale del Gran Paradiso: tra natura e tradizioni](https://www.visititaly.eu/it/luoghi-e-itinerari/parco-nazionale-del-gran-paradiso-tra-natura-e-tradizioni): Gran Paradiso National Park guide: Alpine nature between Piemonte & Aosta
- [The National Park of Abruzzo, Lazio and Molise: Italy's green heart](https://www.visititaly.eu/places-and-tours/the-national-park-of-abruzzo-lazio-and-molise-italy-s-green-heart): Abruzzo-Lazio-Molise National Park: Marsican bear habitat & hiking trails

## Family Travel & Activities

- [10 cose da fare a Napoli con i bambini](https://www.visititaly.eu/it/luoghi-e-itinerari/divertirsi-in-famiglia-a-napoli-parchi-musei-e-attrazioni-per-bambini): Family guide: 10 things to do in Naples with kids, museums & parks
- [Bologna for children: gardens and public parks](https://www.visititaly.eu/places-and-tours/bologna-for-children): Bologna family guide: Montagnola Park & children's public gardens

## Italian Culture & Traditions

- [Italy in February: what to do and where to go](https://www.visititaly.eu/history-and-traditions/italy-to-discover-and-visit-in-february): February travel guide: Carnival, Valentine's Day & Livigno skiing in Italy
- [Vieni a conoscere tutto il meglio dei prodotti Made in Italy](https://www.visititaly.eu/it/storie-e-tradizioni/prodotti-made-in-italy-arredamento-di-design-alta-moda-e-buon-cibo): Made in Italy excellence: Vespa, fashion, design & Italian craftsmanship
- [Granita recipe: taste this delicious Sicilian delicacy](https://www.visititaly.eu/food-and-flavours/the-palermitan-granita-history-of-a-so-long-gastronomic-tradition): Sicilian granita recipe & history from Mount Etna to Madonie mountains
- [Find out Nicholas, the Saint of Bari venerated worldwide](https://www.visititaly.eu/history-and-traditions/nicholas-the-saint-of-barese-people-revered-all-over-the-world): Saint Nicholas of Bari: patron saint festival & Santa Claus origins

## Optional

- [Top 3 siti preistorici in Basilicata](https://www.visititaly.eu/it/luoghi-e-itinerari/top-3-siti-preistorici-in-basilicata): Basilicata prehistoric sites: Notarchirico & Atella Paleolithic parks
